role: The sleep screen shown while the player sleeps: the Leave Bed button and the chat passthrough on Enter.
scope_reason: Sleeping is a ported mechanic (csrc/engine/sleep.c, out/java/snapshots/surv2-bed-s1) and this screen is the client's state while it sleeps.

members.name: initGui
members.note: GuiChat's text field and the Leave Bed button at (width / 2 - 100, height - 40): drawn with the strip, the field's blinking cursor and the button (gui_screen_extra.sleep); its click is the wake gui op's C0B action 3 (play: escape)

members.name: keyTyped
members.note: escape is func_146418_g's wake (the wake gui op); typed text is GuiChat's, whose record is client_cosmetic (a chat line the product does not enter)

members.name: actionPerformed
members.note: The act's ["wake"] op while the sleep screen is open sets client_out.c0b_wake.

members.name: func_146418_g
members.note: The C0B action 3: processEntityAction runs wakeUpPlayer(false, true, true) (sleep.c:sleep_server_wake) ahead of the tick's other C0B actions and the C03. details-blocks-s1 leaves a bed with it.

notes: sleep.h documents the screen as client state with the button unported because no recorded act carries a click on it. lane/idxclient: the screen is drawn (GuiChat.drawScreen's strip and cursor, the button); idx-tpv-s1's asleep frames 100, 103, 106 at 0 px over 25.
